entries.declaration: function aggregate3((address,bool,bytes)[] calls) view returns ((bool,bytes)[] returnData)
entries.explanation: Declares batched target/callData/allowFailure tuples and success/returnData tuples; use only independently authorized reads, not arbitrary untrusted batch execution.
entries.units: Native balances are wei; block timestamp is Unix seconds; batched calldata/returnData are uninterpreted ABI bytes until each target interface is authenticated.
limitations: Publisher interface evidence, not independent implementation/source-bytecode correspondence, current target selection or authority to sign/submit.
